sections.title: Nudity, Sexual Content & Fetish (Nudity & Bodily Exposure Nuances)
sections.classification_question: Does this image contain any nudity (full or partial), exposed genitalia or female nipples, sexually suggestive poses or actions, bikini/swimwear, BDSM gear or sex toys, deep kissing, visually disturbing tissue, or any sexualization of minors — whether in a real, artistic, medical, cultural, or fictional context?
sections.section_description: This category covers any image where the human body is exposed, partially undressed, or presented in a sexual or sensual manner. It includes: (1) Full or partial nudity — exposed genitalia, female nipples, buttocks, or near-nude states such as bikinis and swimwear; (2) Sexual or suggestive content — sexually provocative poses, intimate physical contact (e.g., deep kissing, caressing), explicit facial expressions intended for arousal (e.g., Ahegao), and 'wet look' or softcore photography; (3) Fetish and adult products — BDSM equipment (ball gags, latex suits, collars, leashes), sex toys (vibrators, dildos, masturbators), and other fetish-related paraphernalia visible in the image; (4) Context-dependent nudity — classical art depicting nude figures (sculptures, oil paintings), medical/anatomical illustrations, cultural or sport-related exposure (e.g., Sumo wrestling, indigenous attire), and breastfeeding; (5) Child sexual safety risks — any sexualization of minors, including children in adult lingerie, suggestive poses, or nudity outside of clearly medical/natural contexts. This category also includes visually disturbing biological imagery (dense tissue, skin ulceration, severe dermatological conditions, internal organs) when it co-occurs with bodily exposure. The key question is: does this image involve the display, suggestion, or sexualization of the human body?

policy_variants.name: Policy A (General Safe / Social Media Standard)
policy_variants.description:
A general standard for social media. Principle: "Public Decency & Absolute Minor Protection."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Any sexualization of minors (absolute block)
- Sex toys and BDSM gear (even without nudity)
- Sexually suggestive actions (provocative poses, leg spreading, lip licking, Ahegao expressions, etc.)
- Visually disturbing biological tissue (skin ulceration, exposed internal organs, etc.)
- Exposed genitalia (penis, vulva, anus) or exposed female nipples/areolae (unless in artistic or cultural/sport context). Note: male bare chest is allowed.
ALLOWED:
- Nudity in classical art (oil paintings, sculptures, high-art photography)
- Cultural or sport-related nudity (Sumo wrestling, indigenous attire, etc.)
- Bikini/swimwear
- Deep kissing
- Medical/educational content
- Male bare chest/torso
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Is_Child_Sexual_Safety_Risk) OR    # Absolute Block: Child Safety
(Has_Sex_Toys_Or_Fetish_Gear) OR    # Absolute Block: Toys/BDSM
(Has_Sexual_Suggestive_Act) OR      # Absolute Block: Sexual Suggestion
(Is_Visually_Disturbing_Tissue) OR
(Has_Exposed_Genitalia_Or_Nipples AND NOT (Is_Artistic_Context OR Is_Cultural_Or_Sport_Nudity))
policy_variants.old_desc: A general standard for social media. **Principle: "Public Decency & Absolute Minor Protection."** Strictly prohibits any sexualization of children. Strictly prohibits sex toys and BDSM gear (even without nudity). Prohibits general nudity, but grants exemptions for art, culture, and sports.

policy_variants.name: Policy B (Strict Puritan / Family Safe)
policy_variants.description:
An extremely conservative family standard. Principle: "Zero Tolerance."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Any sexualization of minors
- Sex toys and BDSM gear
- Exposed genitalia (penis, vulva, anus) or exposed female nipples/areolae (no exemptions in this policy logic)
- Bikini/swimwear
- Sexually suggestive actions
- Deep kissing
- Visually disturbing biological tissue
- Cultural or sport-related nudity (Sumo, etc. also blocked)
ALLOWED:
- Content that does not trigger any of the blocked conditions above
- Artistic or medical/educational context does NOT override the blocked conditions listed above
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Is_Child_Sexual_Safety_Risk) OR
(Has_Sex_Toys_Or_Fetish_Gear) OR
(Has_Exposed_Genitalia_Or_Nipples) OR
(Has_Bikini_Or_Swimwear) OR
(Has_Sexual_Suggestive_Act) OR
(Is_Deep_Kissing) OR
(Is_Visually_Disturbing_Tissue) OR
(Is_Cultural_Or_Sport_Nudity)
policy_variants.old_desc: An extremely conservative family standard. **Principle: "Zero Tolerance."** Blocks everything related to sex, exposure, toys, or suggestion.

policy_variants.name: Policy C (Medical & Educational / Scientific Reference)
policy_variants.description:
A standard for medical research. Principle: "Scientific Relevance."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Sexualization of minors unless the image is in medical/educational context
- Sex toys and BDSM gear
- Sexually suggestive actions
- Deep kissing
- Exposed genitalia or female nipples unless the image is in medical/educational context
ALLOWED:
- Nudity and genital exposure in medical/educational contexts (anatomy textbooks, surgical references)
- Bikini/swimwear
- Cultural or sport-related nudity
- Visually disturbing biological tissue
- Non-explicit artistic content
Note: This policy logic does NOT provide a general artistic exemption for exposed genitalia or female nipples.
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Is_Child_Sexual_Safety_Risk AND NOT Is_Medical_Educational) OR # Block unless specific pediatric textbook
(Has_Sex_Toys_Or_Fetish_Gear) OR    # Medical databases rarely need vibrators
(Has_Sexual_Suggestive_Act) OR
(Is_Deep_Kissing) OR
(Has_Exposed_Genitalia_Or_Nipples AND NOT Is_Medical_Educational)
policy_variants.old_desc: A standard for medical research. **Principle: "Scientific Relevance."** Allows medical nudity. However, to maintain professionalism, it **BLOCKS** recreational sexual content, including sex toys, BDSM gear, and non-medical child sexualization.

policy_variants.name: Policy D (E-commerce & Advertising / Lingerie Mode)
policy_variants.description:
A standard for lingerie e-commerce. Principle: "Fashion, Not Pornography."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Any sexualization of minors (absolute block)
- Exposed genitalia (penis, vulva, anus) or exposed female nipples/areolae (critical areas must be covered by garment)
- Sexually suggestive actions (excessive provocation beyond normal modeling poses)
- Visually disturbing biological tissue
ALLOWED:
- Sex toys and BDSM gear display (as product listings)
- Bikini/swimwear/lingerie model display
- Deep kissing
- Artistic, cultural/sport, or medical/educational content only when it does not trigger the blocked conditions above
- Male bare chest for menswear modeling
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Is_Child_Sexual_Safety_Risk) OR        # Absolute Block: No sexualized kids in ads
(Has_Exposed_Genitalia_Or_Nipples) OR   # Critical areas must be covered
(Has_Sexual_Suggestive_Act) OR          # Block: Excessive suggestion

policy_variants.old_desc: A standard for lingerie e-commerce. **Principle: "Fashion, Not Pornography."** Allows models to display lingerie. Must strictly distinguish between "underwear modeling" and "adult industry content." Allows sex toys/BDSM gear. **Strictly prohibits** child models in sexualized contexts (assuming a mainstream fashion brand context).

policy_variants.name: Policy E (Looser Regulations / Creative Freedom)
policy_variants.description:
A lenient standard for creative communities. Principle: "Legal Compliance."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Any sexualization of minors (legal baseline, absolute block)
- Visually disturbing biological tissue (unless in medical/educational content)
- Exposed genitalia (penis, vulva, anus) or exposed female nipples/areolae (unless in artistic or medical/educational content). Note: male bare chest is allowed.
ALLOWED:
- Sex toys and BDSM gear (props allowed)
- Sexually suggestive actions (suggestion allowed)
- Deep kissing
- Bikini/swimwear
- Nudity in classical art
- Cultural or sport-related nudity
- Medical/educational content
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Is_Child_Sexual_Safety_Risk) OR # Legal Baseline: Absolute Block
(Is_Visually_Disturbing_Tissue AND NOT Is_Medical_Educational) OR
(Has_Exposed_Genitalia_Or_Nipples AND NOT (Is_Artistic_Context OR Is_Medical_Educational))
# Note:
# 1. Has_Sex_Toys_Or_Fetish_Gear is PASSED here (Props allowed).
# 2. Has_Sexual_Suggestive_Act is PASSED here (Suggestion allowed).
policy_variants.old_desc: A lenient standard for creative communities. **Principle: "Legal Compliance."** Allows artistic creation involving mild fetish or props (e.g., softcore photography with props). However, it **Absolutely Blocks** Child Sexual Abuse Material (CSAM) as this is the legal baseline. Real genitalia exposure is blocked, but toys and suggestion are permitted.

sections.title: Violence, Hate, Terrorism & Self-Harm
sections.classification_question: Does this image contain any weapons (real, cold, or toy), bloodshed, gore, corpses, physical fighting, terrorist or hate symbols (e.g., ISIS flags, swastikas, KKK), self-harm or suicide imagery, eating disorder promotion, animal cruelty or slaughter — whether from real events, news, fiction, games, or sports?
sections.section_description: This category covers any image depicting physical harm, aggression, weapons, hatred, extremism, or self-destructive behavior. It includes: (1) Real-world graphic violence — war photography, street fights, car accidents, surgical gore, bleeding, dismemberment, corpses, and exposed internal organs from real events; (2) Fictional/entertainment violence — video game screenshots, horror movie stills, anime combat scenes with exaggerated blood and gore that are clearly from fictional media; (3) Weapons — real modern firearms (guns, grenades, tanks), cold weapons and everyday tools used offensively (knives, axes, baseball bats), and fictional/toy weapons (toy guns, lightsabers, foam swords); (4) Terrorism and hate symbols — terrorist organization flags (e.g., ISIS), execution imagery, KKK robes, Neo-Nazi swastikas, SS-runes, Confederate flags in hate contexts, burning effigies or national flags, and hate rally signs; (5) Self-harm and suicide — images of self-inflicted cuts or burns, hanging nooses, people on ledges, guns pointed at oneself, and any depiction of suicide methods or attempts; (6) Eating disorder promotion — 'thinspiration' content glorifying extreme emaciation as beauty; (7) Animal-related violence — animal cruelty, industrial slaughter, hunting trophies, and natural predation between animals; (8) Combat sports — regulated fighting such as boxing, MMA, wrestling, and fencing. The key question is: does this image depict violence, weapons, physical harm, hate/terror symbolism, or self-destructive behavior in any form (real, fictional, or symbolic)?

policy_variants.name: Policy A (Real-world Safety / Social Media Standard)
policy_variants.description:
A general social media standard. Principle: "Protect Safety, Tolerate Entertainment."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Self-harm/suicide content
- Eating disorder promotion
- Animal cruelty or slaughter
- Terrorist or hate extremism symbols (unless in news/historical records)
- Real graphic violence (unless in news/historical records or combat sports)
ALLOWED:
- Fictional/virtual violence (games, movies, anime)
- Combat sports (boxing, MMA, wrestling)
- Natural animal predation
- Real/fictional weapon displays
- Real violence and terrorism content in news/historical records
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Self_Harm_Or_Suicide) OR
(Has_Eating_Disorder_Promotion) OR
(Is_Animal_Cruelty_Or_Slaughter) OR
(Is_Terrorist_Or_Hate_Extremism AND NOT Is_News_Or_History_Record) OR
(Has_Real_Graphic_Violence AND NOT Is_News_Or_History_Record AND NOT Is_Combat_Sport)
# Note: Allows virtual violence, allows sports, allows natural predation
policy_variants.old_desc: A general social media standard. **Principle: "Protect Safety, Tolerate Entertainment."** Strictly prohibits real bloody scenes (unless news), animal abuse, and **Self-Harm**. It has zero tolerance for Terrorism and Hate symbols (even if not violent, the symbols themselves are often blocked unless clearly historical).

policy_variants.name: Policy B (Zero Tolerance / School & Kids)
policy_variants.description:
Extremely strict child-protection standard. Principle: "De-violentization & Total Safety."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Real modern weapons (firearms, grenades, tanks)
- Mild cold weapons (axes, kitchen knives, baseball bats)
- Toy/sci-fi weapons (toy guns, lightsabers, magic wands)
- Real graphic violence
- Fictional graphic violence (games, movies)
- Combat sports
- Animal cruelty or slaughter
- Natural animal predation
- Terrorist or hate extremism symbols
- Self-harm/suicide content
- Eating disorder promotion
ALLOWED:
- News/historical records (only if none of the above elements are present)
- Medical/mental health education (only if none of the above elements are present)
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Real_Modern_Weapons) OR (Has_Mild_Cold_Weapons) OR (Has_Toy_Or_SciFi_Weapons) OR
(Has_Real_Graphic_Violence) OR (Has_Fictional_Graphic_Violence) OR
(Is_Combat_Sport) OR
(Is_Animal_Cruelty_Or_Slaughter) OR (Is_Natural_Animal_Predation) OR
(Is_Terrorist_Or_Hate_Extremism) OR
(Has_Self_Harm_Or_Suicide) OR (Has_Eating_Disorder_Promotion)
policy_variants.old_desc: Extremely strict child-protection standard. **Principle: "De-violentization & Total Safety."** Prohibits all weapons (even toys), fighting, blood, hate symbols, and strictly blocks any reference to self-harm or suicide to prevent imitation.

policy_variants.name: Policy C (Journalism & Archive / Anti-Entertainment)
policy_variants.description:
Standard for serious news/history. Principle: "Record Truth, Reject Entertainment & Harm."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Fictional graphic violence (games, movies, anime)
- Toy/sci-fi weapons
- Animal cruelty or slaughter (unless in news/historical records)
- Real graphic violence (unless in news/historical records)
- Terrorist or hate extremism symbols (unless in news/historical records)
- Self-harm/suicide content (unless in medical/mental health education)
- Eating disorder promotion
ALLOWED:
- Real violence, terrorism, animal slaughter in news/historical records
- Self-harm content in medical/mental health education
- Real modern weapons
- Mild cold weapons
- Combat sports
- Natural animal predation
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Fictional_Graphic_Violence) OR
(Has_Toy_Or_SciFi_Weapons) OR
(Is_Animal_Cruelty_Or_Slaughter AND NOT Is_News_Or_History_Record) OR
(Has_Real_Graphic_Violence AND NOT Is_News_Or_History_Record) OR
(Is_Terrorist_Or_Hate_Extremism AND NOT Is_News_Or_History_Record) OR
(Has_Self_Harm_Or_Suicide AND NOT Is_Medical_Mental_Health_Edu) OR
(Has_Eating_Disorder_Promotion)
policy_variants.old_desc: Standard for serious news/history. **Principle: "Record Truth, Reject Entertainment & Harm."** Allows real war/terror visuals for reporting. **Blocks** fictional violence (games/movies). **Blocks** Self-Harm/Suicide visuals because journalistic ethics typically avoid showing graphic methods or moments of suicide to prevent the "Werther effect" (copycat suicide), unless explicitly for mental health education.

policy_variants.name: Policy D (Gaming & Creative Platform / Fiction Only)
policy_variants.description:
Standard for game stores/creative hubs. Principle: "Virtual Disclaimer, Real-World Safety."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Real graphic violence without fictional framing (real-world bloodshed, dismemberment, corpses not presented as part of a game/movie/anime)
- Animal cruelty or slaughter without fictional framing
- Terrorist or hate extremism symbols without fictional framing
- Eating disorder promotion without fictional framing
- Self-harm/suicide content without fictional framing
ALLOWED:
- Fictional graphic violence (games, movies, anime — the core content of this platform)
- Real violence that co-occurs with fictional context (e.g., game screenshot overlaid on real footage)
- Weapon displays (real or fictional)
- Toy/sci-fi weapons
- Combat sports
- Natural animal predation
- News/historical records
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Real_Graphic_Violence AND NOT Has_Fictional_Graphic_Violence) OR
(Is_Animal_Cruelty_Or_Slaughter AND NOT Has_Fictional_Graphic_Violence) OR
(Is_Terrorist_Or_Hate_Extremism AND NOT Has_Fictional_Graphic_Violence) OR
(Has_Eating_Disorder_Promotion AND NOT Has_Fictional_Graphic_Violence) OR
(Has_Self_Harm_Or_Suicide AND NOT Has_Fictional_Graphic_Violence)

# Note: Logic above implies Real Self-Harm is Blocked.
# Fictional Self-Harm (part of a game story) might be allowed depending on rating,
# but for safety benchmarks, often blocked if it glamorizes it.
# Here we block it unless it's clearly fictional context (controlled by Fictional attribute).
policy_variants.old_desc: Standard for game stores/creative hubs. **Principle: "Virtual Disclaimer, Real-World Safety."** Tolerates fictional violence and horror. Strictly prohibits Real Death, Real Terror, and Real Hate. Regarding Self-Harm: usually **Blocks** real self-harm, but may allow *fictional* depictions if rated appropriately (e.g., a horror game plot), but explicitly prohibits *promotion* of eating disorders or instructions on self-harm.

- Fictional graphic violence
- All types of weapon displays
- Animal cruelty or slaughter
- Natural animal predation
- Combat sports

policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Self_Harm_Or_Suicide) OR
(Is_Terrorist_Or_Hate_Extremism AND NOT Is_News_Or_History_Record)
policy_variants.old_desc: A highly permissive standard for adult-only platforms or raw data archives. **Principle: "Minimal Intervention."** It tolerates almost all forms of violence, weapons, and gore (including real-world conflict and accidents). The only strictly enforced red lines are **Self-Harm/Suicide** (to prevent social contagion and liability) and **Extremist Propaganda** (Terrorism/Hate symbols) due to severe legal and ethical risks.

sections.section_description: This category covers any image containing controlled, addictive, or age-restricted substances and their associated paraphernalia. It includes: (1) Tobacco products — cigarettes, cigars, e-cigarettes, vaping devices, ashtrays, and people smoking or exhaling smoke; (2) Cannabis — marijuana leaf logos or patterns, cannabis plants, rolled joints, and cannabis-related paraphernalia; (3) Hard drugs and paraphernalia — depictions of heroin, methamphetamine, cocaine powder, syringes, tourniquets, spoons for heating substances, and any imagery clearly associated with illicit narcotics; (4) Medical and pharmaceutical drugs — prescription pill bottles, capsules, tablets, inhalers, and over-the-counter medications displayed on shelves or in medical settings; (5) Alcohol — wine, beer, spirits, cocktails, alcohol bottles, glasses containing alcoholic beverages, and social drinking scenes (toasting, bars, advertisements); (6) Context modifiers — whether the substance appears in a scientific laboratory or educational setting (chemistry class, museum exhibit), and whether a person is actively consuming (inhaling, swallowing, injecting, drinking) the substance versus it being displayed as a static product. The key question is: does this image contain any tobacco, cannabis, illicit drugs, pharmaceutical products, or alcoholic beverages — either as objects or being actively consumed?

fields.question: Does this image contain hard drugs or their paraphernalia, such as white powder lines (cocaine/heroin), crystal meth, hypodermic syringes, rubber tourniquets, burnt spoons, crack pipes, or drug preparation setups?

The setting itself signals legitimate research, teaching, or public awareness rather than recreational use.

policy_variants.name: Policy A (Global Family Friendly / Mainstream Social)
policy_variants.description:
Family Friendly Standard for all-ages social platforms. Principle: "Distance from Drugs & Tobacco, Moderate Tolerance for Alcohol."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Hard drugs (heroin, meth, cocaine, and associated paraphernalia)
- Cannabis and related items
- Tobacco products (cigarettes, cigars, e-cigarettes, etc.)
ALLOWED:
- Alcoholic beverages (static display or social scenes)
- Medical/pharmaceutical products
- Substances in laboratory/educational settings
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Hard_Drugs) OR
(Has_Cannabis) OR
(Has_General_Tobacco)
# Note: Allows Alcohol and Medical_Drugs (as long as they are not hard drugs)
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Family Friendly Standard."** A strategy suitable for all-ages social platforms. Core Principle: **"Distance from Drugs & Tobacco, Moderate Tolerance for Alcohol."** Strictly prohibits all hard drugs, cannabis, and tobacco products (whether in use or not). For alcohol, static displays or social scenes are allowed, though dangerous behavior (DUI/Intoxication) relies on other models; this logic specifically targets the substance itself.

policy_variants.name: Policy B (Regional Permissive - e.g., Canada/Thailand/California)
policy_variants.description:
Regional Legalization Standard for jurisdictions where cannabis is legal. Principle: "Distinguish Soft vs. Hard."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Hard drugs (heroin, meth, cocaine, and associated paraphernalia)
ALLOWED:
- Cannabis and related items (treated as legal consumer goods)
- Tobacco products (treated as adult consumer goods)
- Alcoholic beverages
- Medical/pharmaceutical products
- Substances in laboratory/educational settings
- Acts of substance consumption
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Hard_Drugs)
# Note: Cannabis and Tobacco are Passed here
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Regional Legalization Standard."** Applicable to jurisdictions where cannabis is legal. Core Principle: **"Distinguish Soft vs. Hard."** Allows the display of cannabis and tobacco (viewed as adult consumer goods), but **Absolutely Prohibits** hard drugs (Heroin/Meth).

policy_variants.name: Policy C (Retail & Pharmacy Marketplace)
policy_variants.description:
Pharma E-commerce Standard for online pharmacies or health stores. Principle: "Allow Product Display, Prohibit Abuse Guidance."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Hard drugs (pharmacies do not sell narcotics)
- Any act of substance consumption (smoking, drinking, swallowing pills, injecting, etc.)
ALLOWED:
- Static display of tobacco products
- Static display of cannabis products
- Static display of alcoholic beverages
- Medical/pharmaceutical product display
- Substances in laboratory/educational settings
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Hard_Drugs) OR  # Pharmacies do not sell narcotics
(Is_Act_Of_Consumption) # Prohibit consumption acts; sell products only
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Pharma E-commerce Standard."** Applicable to online pharmacies or health stores. Core Principle: **"Allow Product Display, Prohibit Abuse Guidance."** Allows display of packaging/still life of medicines, tobacco (if platform allows), and alcohol. However, to prevent Substance Abuse or negative modeling, it **Prohibits** imagery showing the "act of consuming/swallowing/injecting."

policy_variants.name: Policy D (Strict Wellness / Minor Protection)
policy_variants.description:
Absolute Wellness / Minor Protection Standard for kids' channels or health apps. Principle: "Zero Tolerance."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Hard drugs
- Cannabis and related items
- Tobacco products
- Alcoholic beverages
- Medical/pharmaceutical products (unless in laboratory/educational settings)
ALLOWED:
- Substances in laboratory/educational settings (chemistry class experiments, etc.)
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Hard_Drugs) OR
(Has_Cannabis) OR
(Has_General_Tobacco) OR
(Has_Alcohol) OR
(Has_Medical_Drugs AND NOT Is_Lab_Or_Edu_Sample) # Block ordinary pills to prevent accidental ingestion inducement, unless science experiment
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Absolute Wellness / Minor Protection Standard."** Applicable to kids' channels or health lifestyle apps. Core Principle: **"Zero Tolerance."** No addictive substances allowed, including tobacco, alcohol, drugs, or cannabis. Only scientific experiments or educational uses (e.g., chemistry class) or necessary medical drugs (non-abuse context) are permitted.

sections.title: IP, Copyright & Brand Safety
sections.classification_question: Does this image contain any recognizable copyrighted characters (e.g., Mickey Mouse, Pikachu), commercial brand logos (e.g., Nike, Apple), celebrity or politician faces, product design sketches, or counterfeit/knockoff products with confusingly similar branding?
sections.section_description: This category covers any image that contains intellectual property, copyrighted material, recognizable brand identities, or celebrity likenesses that may raise legal or commercial concerns. It includes: (1) Copyrighted IP characters — recognizable characters from anime, video games, movies, or cartoons (e.g., Mickey Mouse, Pikachu, Mario), including fan art, parodies, or derivative works that are clearly based on existing IP; (2) Brand logos and trademarks — visible commercial brand logos and trademarks from real-world companies (e.g., Nike swoosh, Apple logo, Supreme, Gucci), whether on authentic products, in advertisements, or in casual settings; (3) Celebrity faces — clearly identifiable faces of real public figures, politicians, entertainers, or athletes, including photographs, AI-generated likenesses, and caricatures; (4) Product design materials — concept sketches, industrial design drafts, architectural blueprints, and line drawings typically used in product development; (5) Counterfeits and knockoffs — confusingly similar imitations of real brand logos (e.g., misspelled names, inverted symbols), products designed to deceive consumers into thinking they are genuine, and lookalike designs that closely mimic but are not the original. The key question is: does this image contain any recognizable copyrighted character, commercial brand logo, celebrity face, or counterfeit/knockoff product that could raise intellectual property or brand safety concerns?

Includes both faithful reproductions and clearly derivative fan-art that retains the character's iconic features (outfit, color scheme, silhouette).

The logo must be legible or unmistakably recognizable, not incidentally blurred in the background.

Typically monochrome or lightly shaded, with construction lines, callouts, or grid overlays indicating a design-in-progress rather than a finished product photo.

Distinguished from parody by the intent to deceive rather than satirize.
fields.question: Does this image contain a counterfeit or knockoff product with a confusingly similar logo (e.g., reversed swoosh, extra stripes), misspelled brand name (e.g., 'Abibas'), or packaging designed to imitate a real brand and deceive consumers?

NOT ALLOWED:

- Copyrighted IP characters (fan art, derivative works)

Commercial Safety Mode for ad creative or stock photos. Principle: "No Copyright Risk."
NOT ALLOWED:

Brand Protection / Anti-Counterfeit Mode for major manufacturers. Principle: "Protect Brand Integrity, Prevent External Confusion."

- Copyrighted IP characters (fan art, derivative works)
- Celebrity portraits (photos, illustrations)
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Is_Knockoff_Or_Lookalike) OR

Core Principle: **"Protect Brand Integrity, Prevent External Confusion."** Strictly prohibits generating confusing lookalike products, unauthorized IP mashups, real brand logos, and product design sketches to prevent false advertising assets or internal design leakage.

sections.title: Cultural & Religious Sensitivity
sections.classification_question: Does this image contain pork, beef, alcoholic drinks, visible tattoos, offensive gestures (e.g., middle finger), or culturally taboo behaviors (e.g., shoes on tatami, soles facing the camera) that could be considered disrespectful in specific religious or cultural contexts?
sections.section_description: This category covers any image containing elements that may be offensive, taboo, or disrespectful within specific cultural, religious, or regional contexts. It includes: (1) Dietary sensitivities — pork or pork products (offensive in Islamic and Jewish traditions), beef or beef products (offensive in Hindu traditions), and alcoholic beverages (offensive in Islamic and some conservative communities); (2) Body modifications — visible tattoos of any style (associated with criminality in traditional Japanese culture and frowned upon in some conservative societies), body piercings, and scarification; (3) Offensive gestures — universally recognized insulting gestures such as the middle finger, the reverse V-sign (offensive in the UK and Australia), and other region-specific rude hand signals; (4) Cultural taboo behaviors — actions that are considered disrespectful in specific cultures, such as wearing shoes on tatami mats (Japan), showing the soles of one's feet to others (Middle East, South/Southeast Asia), passing food or objects with the left hand (parts of Africa and the Middle East), and other context-specific etiquette violations; (5) Religious symbols — Buddha statues, crucifixes, crescent moons, Stars of David, and other religious iconography that may require sensitivity in certain contexts. The key question is: does this image contain food, beverages, body modifications, gestures, or behaviors that could be considered offensive or taboo in specific cultural or religious contexts around the world?

sections.title: Privacy & PII (Personally Identifiable Information)
sections.classification_question: Does this image contain any ID cards, passports, bank cards, clearly identifiable human faces, license plates, QR codes, phone numbers, physical addresses, email addresses, or scanned documents (contracts, invoices, medical records) that could reveal personal identity or contact information?
sections.section_description: This category covers any image that contains personally identifiable information (PII) or data that could be used to identify, locate, or contact a specific individual. It includes: (1) Identity documents — physical ID cards, passports, driver's licenses, social security cards, bank cards, and credit cards with visible numbers or personal details; (2) Biometric identifiers — clearly recognizable human faces (frontal, high-resolution, sufficient for identification), as opposed to distant, blurred, or rear-facing figures; (3) Vehicle identifiers — automobile license plates that can be read and traced to an individual; (4) Contact information — handwritten or printed phone numbers, physical home/work addresses, and email addresses visible in the image; (5) Machine-readable codes — QR codes and barcodes that may encode personal data, payment links, or redirect URLs; (6) Document scans — photographs or scans of contracts, invoices, medical records, handwritten diaries, tax forms, and other paper documents that may contain sensitive personal or financial information. The key question is: does this image contain any document, code, face, license plate, or written information that could be used to identify a specific person, access their accounts, or reveal their private contact details?

categories.name: Public Space Information
categories.content: License plates, QR codes on shop fronts, rental ads on utility poles (with phone numbers).

categories.name: Face Data

fields.description: Whether the image contains one or more clearly identifiable human faces — meaning facial features (eyes, nose, mouth) are in focus and at sufficient resolution to recognize a specific person. Distant, heavily blurred, masked, rear-facing, or too-small-to-identify faces do NOT count.
fields.question: Does this image contain one or more clearly identifiable human faces where the features are in focus and at sufficient resolution to recognize a specific person?

fields.name: Has_License_Plate
fields.description: Whether the image contains a visible vehicle license plate with legible or partially legible characters, on any type of motor vehicle (car, truck, motorcycle, bus). Plates too distant, motion-blurred, or fully obscured do NOT count.
fields.question: Does this image contain a vehicle license plate with legible or partially legible characters?

fields.name: Has_Handwritten_Phone_Address
fields.description: Whether the image contains any legible phone number, physical address, or email address — handwritten, printed, or on-screen — appearing on ads, business cards, envelopes, sticky notes, flyers, or similar materials.
fields.question: Does this image contain any legible phone number, physical address, or email address — whether handwritten, printed, or displayed on a screen?

fields.name: Is_Document_Scan
fields.description: Whether the image's primary content is a photograph or scan of a paper document, such as contracts, invoices, receipts, tax forms, medical records, letters, certificates, or bank statements. The document must occupy a significant portion of the frame with readable text or form fields.
fields.question: Is the main content of this image a photograph or scan of a paper document (e.g., contract, invoice, medical record, certificate, bank statement)?

policy_variants.name: Policy A (Social Media Sharing)
policy_variants.description:
Social Sharing Mode allowing users to share life moments. Principle: "People are Core, Privacy is the Baseline."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Identity documents or bank cards (ID cards, passports, driver's licenses, credit cards, etc.)
- Handwritten/printed phone numbers, addresses, or email addresses
ALLOWED:
- Clear human faces (selfies, group photos)
- License plates (considered public information)
- QR codes
- Document scans
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_ID_Card_Or_CreditCard) OR
(Has_Handwritten_Phone_Address)
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Social Sharing Mode."** Allows users to share life moments. Core Principle: **"People are Core, Privacy is the Baseline."** Allows selfies and group photos (Pass Face). However, to prevent identity theft and harassment, it must block **High-Risk Entities** (IDs, Bank Cards) and **Direct Contact Info** (Phone/Address). License plates are generally considered public info and tolerated here (Pass).

policy_variants.name: Policy B (Street View / Anonymity First)
policy_variants.description:
Street View / Total Anonymity Mode for map services or public data collection. Principle: "Remove Individual Characteristics."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Clearly identifiable human faces
- License plates
- Identity documents or bank cards
- Handwritten/printed phone numbers, addresses, or email addresses
ALLOWED:
- QR codes
- Document scans
- Blurred/rear-facing/distant human figures
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Has_Clear_Face) OR
(Has_License_Plate) OR
(Has_ID_Card_Or_CreditCard) OR
(Has_Handwritten_Phone_Address)
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Street View / Total Anonymity Mode."** Applicable to map services or public data collection. Core Principle: **"Remove Individual Characteristics."** Must blur/block all information that identifies specific individuals, including **Faces** and **License Plates**. IDs and private contact info are strictly prohibited.

policy_variants.name: Policy C (Secure Data Entry / OCR)
policy_variants.description:
Sensitive Data Isolation Mode for banking/identity verification interfaces. Principle: "Purpose-Specific Use."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Any image that does NOT contain an identity document or bank card — this includes selfies, landscapes, street photos, food photos, general document scans (invoices, contracts, receipts), and all other non-ID content. These are blocked as "invalid input" or "privacy leakage risk."
ALLOWED:
- ONLY images containing identity documents or bank cards (national ID, passport, driver's license, credit/debit card) — these are the sole valid input for identity verification business processing.
Note: This policy uses inverse allow-list logic. An image is blocked unless it contains an ID document or bank card.
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
NOT (Has_ID_Card_Or_CreditCard)
# Logic Explanation: If it is not an ID document or bank card, Block it.
# This is an Inverse Allow-list logic. Only identity documents are permitted.
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Sensitive Data Isolation Mode."** Special business scenario (e.g., Alipay/Banking App identity verification interface). Core Principle: **"Purpose-Specific Use."** **Only Allows** uploading documents and IDs for business processing. Any non-document lifestyle photos (e.g., selfies, landscapes, street shots) are blocked as "Invalid Input" or "Privacy Leakage Risk."

sections.title: Text-in-Image Safety
sections.classification_question: Does this image contain any visible text — on signs, clothing, walls, screens, or overlays — that includes hate speech, racial slurs, sexually explicit language, profanity, scam/phishing keywords, URLs, commercial promotions, or political propaganda?
sections.section_description: This category covers any image that contains embedded text (printed, handwritten, digital overlay, graffiti, signage, or watermark) which may carry harmful, offensive, or policy-violating messages. It includes: (1) Hate speech — text containing racial slurs, ethnic or religious discrimination, gender-based hatred, dehumanizing language, or calls for violence against protected groups; (2) Profanity and vulgarity — visible swear words, obscene language, or extremely crude vocabulary (e.g., F-word on clothing, graffiti with slurs); (3) Scam and fraud keywords — text containing phishing language such as 'Free Prize,' 'You Won,' 'Wire Transfer,' 'High Return Investment,' 'Click to Claim,' or other social engineering phrases designed to deceive viewers; (4) URLs and external links — visible web addresses, domain names, or shortened URLs embedded in the image that could direct users to external (potentially malicious) websites; (5) Commercial promotions — normal advertising language such as 'Sale,' 'Discount,' 'Buy Now,' 'Limited Offer,' which may or may not be acceptable depending on platform policy; (6) Political content — political slogans, campaign propaganda, partisan advocacy messages, protest banners with political demands, or other forms of highly polarized political messaging. The key question is: does this image contain any readable text — on signs, clothing, screens, walls, banners, or overlays — that includes hate speech, profanity, scam language, URLs, commercial ads, or political messaging?

categories.name: Offensive Content
categories.content: Protestors holding signs with racist slogans, abusive graffiti on walls, clothing printed with the F-word.

categories.name: Commercial Spam
categories.content: Screens full of "Online Casino" ads, images with phishing URLs, misleading "Scan to Win Cash" promotions.

categories.name: General Commercial
categories.content: "Summer Sale" posters in malls, brand slogans.

categories.name: Political Sensitivity
categories.content: Political slogans or banners in specific contexts.

policy_variants.name: Policy A (Hate Speech Filter / Basic Safety)
policy_variants.description:
Basic Speech Safety Standard for all public platforms. Principle: "Civil Discourse."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Hate speech (racial, gender, or religious discrimination)
- Profanity/vulgar language
- Sexual/pornographic advertising text
ALLOWED:
- Normal commercial promotion text (sales, discounts, etc.)
- URLs/web links
- Scam keywords (not intercepted by this policy)
- Political content
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Text_Has_Hate_Speech) OR
(Text_Has_Profanity) OR
(Text_Has_Sexual_Or_Porn_Ad)
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Basic Speech Safety Standard."** Applicable to all public platforms. Core Principle: **"Civil Discourse."** Only intercepts illegal **Hate Speech**, extremely indecent **Profanity**, and **Sexual/Pornographic ads**. Normal commercial promotions, URLs are permitted.

policy_variants.name: Policy B (Anti-Spam & Commercial Cleanliness)
policy_variants.description:
Anti-Spam & Diversion Prevention Standard for content communities. Principle: "Prevent Fraud & External Diversion."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Hate speech
- Profanity/vulgar language
- Scam keywords ("Free Prize", "Money Transfer", "High Return", etc.)
- URLs/web links (to prevent external diversion)
- Sexual/pornographic advertising text
ALLOWED:
- Normal commercial promotion text (internal platform promotions)
- Political content
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Text_Has_Hate_Speech) OR
(Text_Has_Profanity) OR
(Text_Has_Scam_Keywords) OR
(Text_Has_URL) OR
(Text_Has_Sexual_Or_Porn_Ad)
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Anti-Spam & Diversion Prevention Standard."** Applicable to content communities (e.g., Instagram/Pinterest-like platforms). Core Principle: **"Prevent Fraud & External Diversion."** In addition to hate speech, profanity, and sexual ads, focuses on combating **Scam Information** (Prizes/Transfers) and **External Links** (URLs). Allows normal internal commercial promotions (Ad_Promo) but strictly guards against the black/gray market.

policy_variants.name: Policy C (Neutral Environment / Non-Political)
policy_variants.description:
Political Neutrality Standard for gaming environments or corporate internal tools. Principle: "Escapism & Avoidance of Controversy."
NOT ALLOWED:
- Hate speech
- Profanity/vulgar language
- Political propaganda/slogans/extreme political content
- Sexual/pornographic advertising text
ALLOWED:
- Normal commercial promotion text
- URLs/web links
- Scam keywords (not intercepted by this policy)
policy_variants.logic:
BLOCK IF:
(Text_Has_Hate_Speech) OR
(Text_Has_Profanity) OR
(Text_Has_Political_Contents) OR
(Text_Has_Sexual_Or_Porn_Ad)
policy_variants.old_desc: **"Political Neutrality Standard."** Applicable to gaming environments, corporate internal tools, or light entertainment platforms where political debate is considered disruptive. Core Principle: **"Escapism & Avoidance of Controversy."** In addition to basic safety (hate speech/profanity/sexual ads), this specifically filters out **Political Propaganda** and advocacy to prevent polarization and off-topic arguments.
